title: Listen and choose 4.3
role: Tour professional telling a story with advanced narrative tenses
can_do: I can tell a story with the past simple, the past continuous and the past perfect.
I can organise a narrative so that listeners follow what happened first.

items.prompt: What had the musicians already done?
items.explanation: The musicians had already started to play.

items.prompt: How long had the fishermen been waiting?
items.explanation: They had been waiting on the rock for almost a day.

items.prompt: When did they reach the summit?
items.explanation: They reached the summit just before dusk.
